title: Why You Sleep With the TV On 📺
short_title: Why You Sleep With the TV On 📺
title_options: Why You Sleep With the TV On 📺
Reruns Help Your Brain Shut Off 😴
seo_intro:
Why do some people need the TV on to sleep? In silence, the brain's default mode network replays your worries; a familiar rerun gives it something easy to follow, so you can let go.
Full video, the whole night hour by hour and 6 tricks to try tonight: https://youtu.be/69ZCE96ljgI
sources_text: Raichle M.E. et al., PNAS, 2001 (default mode network, active at rest and during mind-wandering); Basner M. et al., The Lancet, 2014 (noise during sleep causes brief arousals); Mason I.C. et al., PNAS, 2022 (light during sleep raises heart rate). Simplified explanation; not medical advice.
disclaimer: Maya is a fictional character. AI-generated illustrations, synthetic voice and AI-generated music. Not medical advice.
